::: {.callout-note}
## Known to exist as a class — copies sought; dates conflict
No original 1993–95 Ministry of Health design file, Treasury Board submission, or pilot instrument was recovered. Later public sources **disagree** on 1993 versus 1994 as an “established” year, and a 2012 official report gives **pilot 1994 / province-wide 1995**. Continuing Care Division / Community Support Branch as the 1995 administrative home is now attested in the inspected [HEU *Guardian* Nov/Dec 1995](1995-heu-guardian-novdec.qmd) feature (union newspaper, not a ministry file). Original 1993–95 design instruments remain unfound.
:::

## Identification

This is a **class of records**, not a single titled publication. The sortable date `1994-01-01` is a midpoint, not a claim that a specific instrument is dated 1994.

| Element | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Original Ministry of Health CSIL pilot/design records (commissioning issue) |
| Date range as named | Approximately 1993–95 (commissioning issue) |
| Administrative home as named in the commissioning issue | Continuing Care Division / Community Support Branch |
| Administrative home as seen in a 1995 public source | [HEU *Guardian* Nov/Dec 1995](1995-heu-guardian-novdec.qmd): “new program of the Community Support Branch of the Continuing Care Division called ‘Choice in Supports for Independent Living’ or CSIL,” “designed as a pilot program.” |
| 1993 “established” claim | [Gauthier 2014](2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd): “Established by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia in 1993…” Same deck: “The Pilot — 50 people tried it out.” |
| 1994 “established” claim | [Gauthier 2015](2015-gauthier-csil-module-1.qmd): “…in 1994…” |
| 1994 start on IFRC staff page | [IFRC Our Team](ifrc-our-team.qmd): Gauthier “started on the CSIL program in 1994.” |
| Later official chronology | [Ombudsperson, *Best of Care* Part 2 (2012)](2012-ombudsperson-best-of-care.qmd): “established as a pilot in 1994 and implemented province-wide in 1995.” |
| Later existence of a named program | *Hutchinson* summary ([2005 CanLIIDocs 513](2005-human-rights-digest-hutchinson.qmd)): client accepted in 1998. |
| Current policy (not a founding record) | [HCC Policy Manual 4.C](hcc-policy-manual-4c.qmd); [gov.bc.ca CSIL page](gov-bc-csil-program-page.qmd). |

## What this pass actually inspected

Inspected: Gauthier 2014 and 2015 decks; IFRC Our Team; *Best of Care* Volume 1 and Overview; current ministry and VCH CSIL pages; HCC Policy Manual chapter 4; 2011 rate-increase news release; *Hutchinson* digest; HEU Nov/Dec 1995 PDF cover and page-9 CSIL passage.

Not inspected: any 1993–95 ministry file; a Legislative Library or BC Archives finding aid for Continuing Care Division CSIL files.

## Near-miss (do not conflate)

The Roeher bibliography cites Kelly MacKinnon, “Individualized Funding Service Brokerage Pilot,” Ministry of Social Services, October 1995 — a **Social Services** IF/brokerage pilot (1991–96), not a demonstrated Ministry of Health CSIL instrument.

## Annotation

Public sources now document, in print, three different start-stories: established 1993; established 1994; piloted 1994 and province-wide 1995. Experiment 002 classified that pattern as **PARTIAL STAGED CHRONOLOGY**: later official wording assigns different meanings to 1994 (pilot) and 1995 (province-wide), while 1993 remains a conflicting later label and late-1995 HEU still says new/pilot. Those sources do not replace the missing ministry instruments, and they do not say what each year authorized (design, Treasury Board approval, pilot intake, or broader availability). ECPM as a formal predecessor is still reconstructed from later accounts ([IFRC Our Team](ifrc-our-team.qmd); [Gauthier 2014](2014-gauthier-sci-csil-presentation.qmd)), not from an inspected 1990s ministry file. See the [CSIL design and pilot chapter](../history/csil-pilot.qmd).

## Open questions

- Which files exist and are public.
- What each dated item authorises.
- Whether “50 people tried it out” (Gauthier 2014) is contemporaneous or later recollection.
- Whether Hansard for 1993–95 names CSIL (not retrieved in this pass).
- What ministry instrument created Community Support Branch CSIL, and whether Sally Hamilton’s role is documented elsewhere.
